svg.title: Side effects in 685 creatine trials: creatine vs placebo
svg.desc: Side effects in 685 creatine trials: creatine vs placebo. Any side effect: placebo 4.21%, creatine 4.6%. GI upset: placebo 4.05%, creatine 5.51%. Muscle cramping or pain: placebo 0.07%, creatine 0.52%. None of these differences was statistically significant.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pooled share of participants reporting each side effect. About 12,800 on creatine, 13,450 on placebo.
